verdict.rationale: Loops documents programmatic management of contacts and mailing lists through its API and official MCP server (loops-docs-24, loops-docs-4). Workflows can also change mailing lists from code (loops-docs-27). Segments, however, appear only as dynamic dashboard constructs (loops-docs-16), and nothing shows segments or tags being created via the API or membership being read back. Missing for 10: API creation/update of segments or tags, documented endpoint to list exactly which contacts belong to a list or segment, hands-on corroboration.
